title: Preparation and structural characterization of a functionalized trigonal organoerbium cluster with two bridging hydroxyl groups and a μ3-oxo group

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: sodium tris(dimethoxyethane) salt of the μ3-oxo-bis(μ-hydroxo)tris{bis[(diphenylphosphino)cyclopentadienyl]erbium} anion

material_class.structural_family: trinuclear organoerbium oxo/hydroxo cluster ion pair

synthesis.procedure: Traces of water in the reaction of ErCl3 with Ph2PC5H4Na, using the same procedure as the reported reaction of anhydrous YbCl3 with Ph2PC5H4Na in tetrahydrofuran at 60 °C under dinitrogen, afforded the organoerbium cluster 1. The product exists as discrete [Na(DME)3]+ and cluster-anion pairs and was isolated in approximately 50% yield based on Ph2PC5H4Na.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: same procedure as the YbCl3/Ph2PC5H4Na reaction under dinitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: X-ray quality crystals of the [Na(DME)3]+ salt were obtained; crystallization details are not given in the main text beyond single-crystal structure analysis.

source_locations.location: Figs. 1–2; Table 1; structural discussion of Er3(O)(OH)2 core
